extracted.intended_audience: public relations and investor relations professionals; PR/IR communicators preparing press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Practical formatting guidance for writing press releases to improve readability, attract media attention, and amplify corporate news. Covers headline writing, ideal length and style, and use of subheadings, bullet points, and quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting correctness / clear structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting your press release correctly is just as important as the content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear, well-structured release makes your news more engaging, grabs media attention and helps your story shine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline that grabs attention
rubrics_metrics.description: How to write a headline that grabs attention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Headlines should be attention-grabbing to increase the chance the media and readers will engage with the release. (Listed as a primary learning objective on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Ideal length and style for readability
rubrics_metrics.description: The ideal length and style for readability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an appropriate length and writing style that maximizes readability; the page frames this as a core best practice to boost how easily media and readers can consume the announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of subheadings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ subheadings to organize content and help journalists and readers scan the release quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of bullet points
rubrics_metrics.description: How to use ... bullet points ... effectively
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use bullet points to highlight key facts and make important information easy to find and digest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of quotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate quotes to add human voice, provide attribution, and underscore the news’ significance; the page lists this as a formatting/content technique to use effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome focus: boost readability and media attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Best Practices to Boost Readability and Media Attention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The overall objective of the formatting tips is to increase readability and attract media attention, framing all formatting choices (headlines, length, subheads, bullets, quotes) around that outcome.
